node: HBM memory stack, interface IP, and memory-controller ecosystem
summary: Expanded the HBM interface/test ecosystem around three US-listed candidates. The strongest direct fits for this underfollowed pass are Rambus as a memory-interface IP and patent/licensing toll-road, FormFactor as a DRAM/HBM wafer probe and known-good-die enablement supplier, and Cohu as an HBM inspection/metrology and semiconductor test automation supplier. These are not buy/sell recommendations; they are Layer 1B research candidates requiring deeper verification of revenue materiality, customer concentration, competitive positioning, and whether HBM/AI exposure is already priced.
